description: This file defines the 'ZeroOrPositive' validation rule within the validation rules for the OrangeHRM API v2. It extends an abstract rule and implements a numeric check to ensure the input is zero or positive.

classes.name: ZeroOrPositive
classes.description: A validation rule class that checks if a given input is a numeric zero or positive value, extending the AbstractRule class.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates whether the input is numeric and greater than or equal to zero.
